statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has a known history of atrial fibrillation
The patient has a prior transient ischemic attack
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73 and I48.91
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
Lakeshore Advantage is the secondary plan
